description: This file defines data structures, enums, classes, and functions related to CUDA FFT plan caching and configuration in the ATen library, including plan creation, parameter hashing, and cache management.

classes.name: CuFFTHandle
classes.description: Manages a cuFFT handle, creating it upon construction and destroying it upon destruction.

classes.name: CuFFTParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for cuFFT plan hashing, including signal dimensions, strides, FFT type, and data type.

classes.name: CuFFTDataLayout
classes.description: Represents data layout information for cuFFT planning, including embedded shape, stride, and distance.

classes.name: CuFFTConfig
classes.description: Contains all information needed to execute a cuFFT plan, including the plan handle, cloning flag, workspace size, FFT type, and data type.

methods.name: cufft_complex_input
methods.description: Returns true if the FFT transform type has complex input.

methods.name: cufft_complex_output
methods.description: Returns true if the FFT transform type has complex output.

methods.name: GetCuFFTTransformType
methods.description: Creates a CuFFTTransformType enum from booleans indicating if input and output are complex.

methods.name: cufft_simple_embed
methods.description: Returns a simple embedded data layout for a contiguous signal of given sizes.

methods.name: as_cufft_embed
methods.description: Converts strides to a cuFFT embedded representation, or sets must_clone if not possible.
